name: HaluEval
description: HaluEval is a large-scale hallucination evaluation benchmark for large language models, containing a collection of generated and human-annotated hallucinated samples. It evaluates LLMs' ability to recognize hallucinations in generated text, with samples created via a ChatGPT-based sampling-then-filtering framework and human annotation.
reputation: A widely used hallucination benchmark for LLMs that is frequently cited in work on factuality and hallucination detection.
notes: Includes human annotations; uses a two-step ChatGPT-based generation and filtering process; highlights challenges in hallucination recognition by LLMs.
